name: guardtab
description: GuardTab — Chrome Extension + Node.js Backend + PostgreSQL security & privacy inspector

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=extension
scripts.build:extension: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=extension
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=extension
scripts.ci:checks: node scripts/check-no-env-files.mjs && node scripts/check-risk-engine-version.mjs && node scripts/check-migrations.mjs
